2609.10372.title: PACE: Perceived-Latency-Aware Cascading Service Routing and Filler Control for QoE-Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Dialogue Serving
2609.10372.paper_summary: We present the PACE, a framework for retrieval-augmented dialogue serving that formalizes Perceived Time-to-First-Response (PTFR) as a QoE objective and minimizes it under quality/cost constraints. Unlike prior work on cascaded routing, semantic caching, or adaptive retrieval, PACE jointly controls which answer source composes the response and what fills the waiting window. Deployed on a humanoid-robot sales service, it combines three mechanisms: a load-adaptive cascading router, a joint path-filler controller, and volatility-aware cache admission. On 75k CarQA requests, the cascade halves pure-LLM PTFR at P95 (0.29 vs 0.53s at c16). The adaptive controller reaches 0.41s P95, outperforming RAG by 2.4 times at high load with equal quality. The filler controller cuts calls by 94% with zero conflict. Volatility-aware admission reduces stale answers from 86% to 0%. A gating rule ensures the controller never worse than the baseline, with exposure bounded by one hold period. This is the first quantification of filler-answer conflict risk in deployed services.
2609.10372.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了 PACE，一個用於檢索增強對話服務的框架，將感知首次響應時間（PTFR）形式化為一個 QoE 目標，並在質量/成本約束下最小化它。與先前在級聯路由、語義快取或自適應檢索方面的工作不同，PACE 共同控制哪些答案來源組成響應以及什麼填充等待窗口。它在一個人形機器人銷售服務中部署，結合了三個機制：一個負載自適應級聯路由器、一個聯合路徑填充控制器和一個考慮波動的快取接納。對於 75k 的 CarQA 請求，級聯將純 LLM 的 P95 PTFR 減半（0.29 vs 0.53s 在 c16）。自適應控制器達到了 0.41s 的 P95，在高負載下以相同質量超越了 RAG 2.4 倍。填充控制器將呼叫減少了 94%，且沒有衝突。考慮波動的接納將陳舊答案從 86% 降低到 0%。一個閘控規則確保控制器的表現不會低於基準，且暴露時間限制在一個保持期內。這是首次量化已部署服務中填充答案衝突風險的研究。
